newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures stabilize higher, in ranges.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures stabilize higher, in ranges.

text.p: May 6 - IMM currency futures stabilized higher, inside ranges. Some said marks, Swiss francs stalled after busy pop up on reported Buba's Welteke comments. Clarification of one news agency's report of his remarks took steam out of quick spike up to day's peak. Weltke spokesman said Welteke did not give any level at which Buba might no longer be happy with dollar.
